children: Supply disruptions are rippling through several commodity markets, and could lead to higher prices should demand hold firm, Jefferies says. In copper, severe storms in Chile have significantly affected mine production, says the bank. In thermal coal, a lack of rain in Indonesia is leading to less supply for the seaborne market, it says. "Meanwhile, the war in the Middle East is also impacting supply chains in the sector," Jefferies says. London Metal Exchange 3-month copper is up 0.1% at $14,535 a metric ton.
